name: Assegno Unico Universale - SIA Project 24 25
description:
Information Systems - academic year 24/25
Course Project

The Universal Single Allowance (Assegno Unico Universale, AUU) is a financial support for Italian families with dependent children, which guarantees financial aid based on the specific conditions and the age of the children. The AUU is paid by the National Social Security Institute (INPS) to those who exercise parental responsibility in the presence of children dependent on them.

The online application can be submitted to INPS either directly by the interested parties or by patronage institutes (patronati) holding a specific mandate. The application must be submitted on the INPS website, by subjects authenticated through one of the following options: SPID; Electronic Identity Card 3.0; National Services Card; PIN. The application can also be submitted from mobile devices and through the call center by calling the toll-free number 803.164 or the number 06 164 164. Here, only the case of submission of the application through the INPS website by the directly interested parties will be described (delegates are therefore excluded from the analysis).

A. APPLICATION ENTRY: PHASE 1 - USER DATA
It is possible to submit an application as:
- Parent;
- Custodial parent;
- Child's guardian.

Depending on the type of applicant, more or fewer fields must be filled in, according to the table below, and in the order in which they appear in the table.

| Field | Parent | Custodial parent | Child's guardian |
|---|---|---|---|
| Child's tax code | X | X | X |
| Declaration that the child is a dependent | X | X | X |
| Disabled child (yes/no) | X | X | X |
| If the child is disabled, degree of disability (Medium, Severe, Non-self-sufficiency) | X | X | X |
| Household (cohabiting parents; non-cohabiting parents; single parent) | X | | |
| Parent with sole custody (yes/no) | | X | |
| If the household is not single-parent, tax code of the other parent | X | X | |
| If the household is not single-parent, method of distribution of the allowance (50% or 100% to the applicant) | X | X | |

Also consider that:
- as soon as the applicant enters the child's tax code, it is verified immediately, in real time: if the child is present in other active applications, the application flow is blocked with an explanatory warning;
- upon submission of the application, in the absence of a valid ISEE already held by INPS, the allowance will be calculated with the minimum amount provided for by the regulations; should the ISEE be submitted to INPS at a later time, the user does not need to update their application: as soon as INPS comes into possession of the ISEE, the amount of the allowance is automatically recalculated.

The step that completes this phase is entering the tax codes of the dependent adult children, for whom it is not possible to request the single allowance but who contribute to determining the number of members of the household. If the tax code of an adult child is already present, an error is reported: the user can decide to try again or to move on to the next step, namely specifying the payment data.

B. APPLICATION ENTRY: PHASE 2 - PAYMENT DATA
When specifying the payment data, if in the previous phase the 50% distribution method with the other parent was declared, it will be required to also enter the payment data of the other parent. Otherwise, only one's own payment data must be entered. In both cases, one of the following payment methods can be chosen:
- credit to accounts with an IBAN, in the SEPA area, held in the name of the applicant and enabled to receive bank transfers (current account, savings book, prepaid card);
- domiciled bank transfer to the applicant at the post office counter;
- credit to a prepaid card for households receiving the Inclusion Income (Reddito di Inclusione).

C. APPLICATION ENTRY: PHASE 3 - DECLARATIONS AND SUBMISSION
The process ends with the reading of the declarations of responsibility and of the privacy notice (GDPR). Once the declarations of responsibility and the GDPR notice have been accepted, it is possible to view a summary of the data entered, useful for checking, before submitting the application, whether everything has been entered correctly. From the application summary it is possible to confirm everything in order to submit it. In case of an error (example: wrong IBAN entered), the application will not be submitted: an explicit error message is shown, the process ends and the user will have to reopen the application and modify the wrong fields. In case of no error, the application will be submitted and it will be possible to download the receipt.

D. APPLICATION VERIFICATION AND PAYMENTS
Once acquired, the application is analyzed by the staff of the competent Offices, who can decide whether to: reject it, because the applicant is not entitled to it; suspend it to request further documentation; accept it. In all cases, the system notifies the applicant. In case of acceptance, the application is valid for 12 months. The amount is paid on a monthly basis, and the payment takes place automatically. In case of suspension, see paragraph F.

E. CONSULTING AND COMPLETING A DRAFT APPLICATION
At any point of the application submission, it is possible either to abort the process without saving any data, or to save the application as a draft - if it has not yet been submitted - in order to continue entering the data at a later time using the dedicated functionality. The application can thus be consulted at any time. From the consultation it is possible to access the application completion functionality: after selecting “Complete”, the system asks whether one wants to continue editing: if this is confirmed (YES) it is possible to continue the submission of the previously saved application (in this case the user finds the data already entered previously). If instead it is not confirmed (NO) the previously saved data will be deleted and it will be possible to proceed with the entry starting from scratch.

F. ADDING ATTACHMENTS
If the application has been suspended to request further documents (see paragraph D), the notification also includes a message from the operator indicating the missing document(s). The user will then have to view their application and add the requested attachments. At the end of the addition, they will have to confirm again all the data present, and read and confirm the declarations of responsibility and the privacy notice.

G. COMPLETING THE APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED BY THE OTHER PARENT
Through this function it is possible to supplement the application filled in by the other parent. In this case one is not the applicant, i.e. the person who submits the application for the allowance, but the second parent. The main functionality that can be performed as the other parent, in addition to consulting the application data, is updating the payment method, i.e. it is possible to decide whether or not to confirm the allowance distribution requests made by the applicant. More precisely, if the applicant requests the allowance at 100%, as the other parent it is possible to confirm the request, by selecting “Paid 100% to the applicant”, otherwise it is possible not to confirm it by selecting “Distributed 50% between the parents”. If the request for the allowance at 100% is not confirmed, then one will have to enter one's own payment data. If, instead, the applicant requests the allowance at 50% for both parents, then it is possible to enter only the payment method. The process continues as described in paragraph C.

H. ADDING CHILDREN
It is possible to add one or more children to a pre-existing application. The data of the additional child(ren) are entered one at a time. In this case too, as soon as the applicant enters the child's tax code, it is verified immediately, in real time: if the child is present in other active applications, the application flow is blocked with an explanatory warning. Once the new data have been entered, the process continues as reported in paragraphs B and C: in this case, however, the data are already entered and it is possible to confirm or modify them.

I. FURTHER FUNCTIONALITIES
Finally, bear in mind that the system also makes the following operations possible for the citizen:
- Consult the submitted applications;
- Consult the general information on the single allowance for children;
- Simulate the amount of the monthly allowance.

Analysis
Analyze the scenario outlined above and define:
1. The conceptual information model (UML class diagram).
2. The process model (BPMN process diagram), with the exception of paragraph “I. FURTHER FUNCTIONALITIES”.
3. The use case model (UML UC diagram) at summary and user-goal level.
4. The narrative of the use cases at user-goal level identified in the previous point, with the exception of paragraph “I. FURTHER FUNCTIONALITIES”.
5. Evaluate advantages and disadvantages of developing a web system corresponding to the use cases described in point 4 by comparing two different alternatives (in both cases consider as a reference 250 working days per year, 8 working hours per day).
   a. The development is carried out by a team composed of 3 new hires (graduates in computer engineering for less than one year) and 1 senior project manager who has already coordinated a similar project. As for the new hires, consider that they will work the whole time exclusively on the AUU project and that they have a gross annual salary (RAL) of 35,000 euros. The senior, instead, will divide their time among 5 different projects (assume an equal distribution of time among projects), and with a RAL of 75,000 euros.
   b. A consulting company takes charge of the development, entrusting it to its own team of 5 developers with experience in similar systems. A senior analyst, she too with experience in similar systems, has been put in charge of the project. All 6 have been assigned to the project for half of their time, and the average cost per person of the team is 150 euros per day. In addition to these there is an INPS project manager who will follow the progress of the project: for her, consider a RAL of 80,000 euros and an occupation of her time of 5%.
